What if the freelancer disappears after I pay?
Your money is still sitting safely in escrow — it was never sent to them. If a freelancer goes silent raise it with our team and we'll help resolve it which can include a full refund.
What if we disagree about the work?

Most disagreements get sorted directly between you and the freelancer within a short window. If you can't agree, our team reviews both sides — the original brief, the delivered work and your messages — and decides: release, refund, or split fairly.
Why do I need to verify my identity (KYC)?
